best_idea: Keep two counters per technique, one for what the player has drilled and one for what they have fought with, and let the fought counter catch up faster when it is far behind the drilled one, so study and practice both matter without a fixed timer.
decision_why: The two-track catch-up suits technique learning (Pit drills as theory, server-verified fight hits as practice); rust is rejected for now because it needs a day clock the duel does not have.
acceptance: After 10 server-verified practice awards, a player with drilled theory 5 has more practical XP on that technique than a player with no theory, and theory never gains more than 90 percent of a practical gain on any single award.
